items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: get this album by Johnny Hodges or this album by Ben Webster, or this album by Coleman Hawkins, or Roy Eldridge, or Dizzy, and listen to it,

ctx.x: He was, yes. I’m thankful that I was fortunate enough to have been reared in that era, even though I was a bystander, I was a listener at the outset of it, and was fortunate enough to be able to hear all of these greats and learn from them. And that’s the thing that I tell, I teach at York University in Toronto, and I tell the young players, you know they come to me with problems, I say, “go down to the record library and get this album by Johnny Hodges or this album by Ben Webster, or this album by Coleman…
